title: Coalesce virtualized viewport page loads
prompt:
Repair `ViewportFeedController` so overlapping desktop and mobile viewport notifications never start duplicate transport requests for the same page in the active view. Visible work must join an already-running prefetch, prefetch must join an already-running visible load, and unrelated pages must remain free to load concurrently. Keep forward prefetch eager and non-blocking: a viewport update waits for its visible pages, never its speculative pages.

Preserve both cancellation boundaries. Cancelling one `UpdateViewportAsync` call cancels only that caller's wait; it must not cancel transport work shared by another caller. `ChangeView` must cancel transport work owned by the old view, clear old page state, and fence out a cancellation-ignoring stale response. A failed, source-cancelled, or invalid page response must leave in-flight state so the next viewport notification can retry. `GetPageError` must retain the last failure while a retry is pending and clear it only after that page succeeds.

Pages may finish out of order, but `Items` must remain ordered first by page and then by source order. Selection remains keyed by item ID: loading or rebuilding pages must not alter `SelectedId`, and `SelectedItem` must rebind to the matching published instance when it appears. Preserve the public API, validation, end-of-list behavior, disposal behavior, and source contracts. Do not add package dependencies or modify protected files. Run `bash test_incremental_load.sh` from the repository root to verify the repair.
